conventions.pages: Exactly one page component per route in routes.json; page files fetch data, feature/ui components stay presentational.
conventions.naming: Components PascalCase.tsx, hooks useCamelCase.ts, everything else camelCase.ts.
conventions.api: src/api/* is the ONLY place fetch happens. Types mirror openapi.yaml component schemas verbatim; error envelope parsed into ApiError {code, message, details}.
conventions.validation: src/lib/validation.ts implements validation-rules.json (same rule order, exact messages) for inline UI validation; the server remains authoritative.
conventions.tokens: No raw hex/px in components — Tailwind classes generated from tokens.json only.

tree.tailwind.config.ts: theme.extend generated from tokens.json (colors, spacing sm/md/lg, radius, font sizes body/h1/h2/h3/small, breakpoints 376px/1024px)

public/.assets/: copied verbatim from the design pack assets/ folder (see assets-manifest.md) — serves /assets/products/*.svg and /assets/icons/*.svg

src/.router.tsx: Route table from routes.json incl. ProtectedRoute wrapper and * fallback

api/.client.ts: fetch wrapper: base URL, Authorization header, ApiError parsing, 401 → session-expired handling (state-transitions.md §3)
api/.types.ts: TS mirrors of openapi.yaml schemas (User, Product, Cart, CartItem, Order, ...)

auth/.AuthContext.tsx: JWT storage (memory + localStorage), login/logout, expiry handling (NFR-001, REQ-012)

ui/.Button.tsx: primary | secondary | ghost | danger × default/hover/disabled/loading (mockup gallery)

lib/.format.ts: money (2dp USD strings), dates (long form, e.g. '9 July 2026')

styles/.index.css: Tailwind layers + the few globals (focus ring)

tests/.e2e/: Playwright specs per user flow (user-features.md B1)
